description: Otis is the world's leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, service and modernization company, serving customers in over 200 countries and territories around the world, with global scale and local focus, more than 1,400 branches and offices and a direct physical presence in more than 70 countries. It is a Delaware corporation incorporated on March 1, 2019 in connection with the separation and distribution of each of Otis and Carrier Global Corporation from United Technologies Corporation, subsequently renamed RTX Corporation, into separate independent publicly traded companies, with the Separation occurring on April 3, 2020, and it completed the Separation pursuant to a Separation and Distribution Agreement and other agreements with UTC and Carrier related to the Separation, including a tax matters agreement, an employee matter agreement and an intellectual property agreement.
